title: The Effect of US Holidays on the European Markets: When the Cat's Away...
authors: Casado; Muga; Santamaria; given names not verified
summary: Owned US futures are not the European native targets. Preserve prior pre/post-holiday failures; no target inversion into US futures.
about: European market behavior when the US cash market is shut.
findings: Abstract describes holiday/previous-US-return conditioning in European futures; no net edge independently verified.
mechanism: Reduced US participation can alter information/liquidity; a US holiday is not a compulsory signed trade.
build_on: Owned US futures are not the European native targets. Preserve prior pre/post-holiday failures; no target inversion into US futures.
can_strategy_code_be_made: Requires full European rules and data; not faithfully from existing US exports.
